gloss: to raise, to hold up; to advocate

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {掲|かか}げていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to raise, to hold up, to hoist
definitions.explanation: To lift something up high so it can be seen — a flag, a sign, a banner, or a light.

definitions.gloss: to advocate, to put forward, to espouse
definitions.explanation: To publicly declare a goal, ideal, policy, or slogan. Used when a person or organization prominently promotes a principle or objective.

definitions.gloss: to publish, to post, to list
definitions.explanation: To display or publish information in a visible place — a notice, an article, or a list.

notes:
{掲|かか}げる has three related meanings that all involve making something visible or prominent — physically raising something, publicly declaring principles, or publishing information.
